title: What are the trends shaping beauty and wellness fulfilment right now?
summary: Beauty trends can change quickly. Looksmaxxing, skin longevity, peptides, seasonal scents and colour palettes, and hybrid products such as skin tints are all influencing what consumers are looking for. But behind those trends, fulfilment is having to adapt too
